name: Blindness/Deafness
summary: A creature you can see makes a Con save or is Blinded or Deafened (your choice) for 1 minute.
text: Choose one creature you can see within range. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded or Deafened condition (you choose which) for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. You can target one more creature for each spell slot level above 2.
